```ad-note
title:### Greatsword of Death
```
```ad-check
title: ### Stat Beschreibung:
Typ: Spell
Element: Deathfire
Icon: icons/magic/death/weapon-sword-skull-purple.webp
Category: Buff
Cost: 3 Actions, 20 IP
Range: 6m (1,5m width) / 3m half circle
Target: Line or half circle from User
Check: No Check
Duration: 5 turns
Effect: On cast:
Your held weapon becomes engulfed in deathfire, temporarily transforming it into a Greatsword for 5 turns.
This weapon deals 1d12 + (lvl * 1).

Whenever you attack with the Greatsword of Death, choose one of the following AoE shapes:

Halfcircle: 3-meter radius
Line: 6 meters long

Make one Weapon Attack roll. That roll is treated as an attack against every unit within the chosen AoE.
```
```ad-example
title: ### Beschreibung:
Coat your weapon in a roaring mass of deathfire, shaping it into a colossal blade. With a single sweeping strike, reap everything caught in its path.
```
